purpose: Choose whether the next research direction should retain null-presentation conditioning (A) or role-free presentation conditioning (B) using already sealed final checkpoints. This screen is a directional engineering/research decision only; it cannot claim FIT8 qualification, unseen generalization, product promotion, or canonical-M authority.

reason_for_new_screen.observed_v9_6_snake: A_NULL_PRESENTATION reached the 131072 operational token ceiling at 26008 faces without EOS; this is operational truncation, not a valid scientific EOS failure.
reason_for_new_screen.observed_v9_6_bat: A_NULL_PRESENTATION produced EOS but codec decoding raised TESSA_DECODE_DUPLICATE_FACE; this is a structural-invalid candidate and should be recorded, not crash the harness.
reason_for_new_screen.design_conclusion: The immediate decision is A versus B direction, not full qualification. A bounded paired screen on two informative subjects can answer that decision at far lower wall-clock cost while preserving the exact sealed models and inference semantics.

subject_selection.George_reason: Deliberately difficult FIT8 case chosen to test whether the added evidence helps under structural complexity.
subject_selection.Bat_reason: Morphologically distinct case with an already observed A-arm duplicate-face EOS failure; selection is diagnostic and therefore explicitly post-diagnostic, not confirmatory.

arms.A_NULL_PRESENTATION: sealed final A checkpoint; shared scene + surface/mechanics + null presentation memory
arms.B_ROLE_FREE_PRESENTATION: sealed final B checkpoint; shared scene + surface/mechanics + inference-admissible role-free presentation memory

teacher_forced_probe.purpose: Cheap deterministic fit signal; never sufficient by itself because teacher forcing can hide autoregressive instability.

directional_decision_rule.hard_invalid_precedence: For a subject, if exactly one arm enters a typed hard-invalid state and the other does not, the non-invalid arm wins that subject regardless of teacher-forced objective.

teacher_forced_subject_vote_if_validity_.rule: An arm wins the subject if TOTAL_OBJECTIVE is at least 1% lower and neither coordinate absolute-bin error nor structural-special-token CE regresses by more than 3%. Otherwise subject vote is TIE.

directional_decision_rule.primary_16k_decision: If George and Bat both vote for the same arm, select that arm. If one votes for an arm and the other is TIE, select that arm only if its two-subject macro TOTAL_OBJECTIVE is at least 1% lower and it has no additional hard-invalid state. Otherwise run the 32K extension.
directional_decision_rule.32k_extension_decision: Re-run the same two sealed-arm/subject pairs at 32768 tokens only when 16K is inconclusive. Apply the same hard-invalid precedence; teacher-forced metrics remain identical. If still split or tied, result is INCONCLUSIVE rather than inventing a winner.

interpretation.SELECT_A: Do not invest the next architecture iteration in the current role-free presentation-conditioning formulation; retain/null-baseline direction pending redesign.
interpretation.SELECT_B: Continue the role-free/shared-presentation-evidence direction into the next architecture iteration; full qualification remains future work.
interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: Do not claim either arm is better from this screen; redesign measurement or add an independently preregistered tie-break experiment.
